text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While taking a walk with Tanino Gimlet,
I spotted a beautifully shining stone
lying by our feet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —This is...
choice_data_list: Jewels? I've got plenty of bottle caps, though...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Feelings, huh? Intense, yet fleeting.
Holding a swirling... heat within.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: According to Tanino Gimlet's discerning eye, it seemed to be a real gemstone. Perhaps it fell off some jewelry.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Give it here, Trainer.
I'll hold onto it for you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Looks like someone lost something, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Is that you?
Have you come to quench your thirst along your journey?
Yet there is no fine wine here to moisten your throat.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu, is that so? ...By the way, that gemstone. It seems to be quite valuable.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it would suit you very well, too.
So... what do you intend to do?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The darkness named myself is not as gentle as the night.
Dazzling feelings can sometimes become shackles.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Nearly overwhelmed by the unique atmosphere around the two of them, I suddenly came to my senses. At any rate, we decided to report it to the police box, but—

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! That jewel...
I was the one who dropped it.
Man, you really saved me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A man suddenly called out from behind.
He showed me a bracelet with a missing stone,
presenting it as proof, but...

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me!
I just overheard you mention a dropped jewel...
Could it by any chance be a red stone!?

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
I was planning to turn it into a pendant,
but I dropped it somewhere, so I was on my way
to the police box...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dear me... What a strange turn of events.
To have two different people claim to be the owner.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "It would be easy to make a judgment here, but... to ensure fairness, how about we let the police box decide?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...It's easy to clean up, too.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...The stone is within my grasp.
Lamenting, while seeking its true master, no less.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, can you hear it too?
The lamentation of the stones about to be stolen,
the screams cursing the fools...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Even straining my ears, I hear nothing, but
judging by the situation, the jewel is—"
choice_data_list: It's not the right size for a bracelet

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, correct.
...And you. How do you know
that we possessed the stone?

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: O-Of course I did... Because I saw where you picked it up...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
From the riverbank to here...
It's quite a distance. Why didn't you call out to me right away?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me you prepared a fake bracelet
and went out of your way to remove the stones?

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it all...!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, now, now, that won't do.
Did you really think you could outrun an Umamusume's legs?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Rob them of their purpose—
and the vines shall entangle the sinner, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We handed the man who attempted the fraud over to the police box.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
We never mentioned the color.
Furthermore, the stone remained hidden in hand the whole time.
...Yet, you still said it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: A deep crimson dyed in love, you say?

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
D-Did I say that...?
I certainly said 'red', but...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —The answer was clear.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it all...!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, now, now, that won't do.
Did you really think you could outrun an Umamusume's legs?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Rob them of their purpose—
and the vines shall entangle the sinner, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We handed the man who attempted the fraud over to the police box.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
Actually, it's a keepsake from my late wife.
Thank you so much, you saved me.
If it's alright, please let me give you a token of my gratitude...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I was overwhelmed by such dazzling passion.
Heh... feels like I've gotten sick off strong drink.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tanino Gimlet kept mentioning "feelings." Could she really have heard the gemstone's voice...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Declining the man's thanks, Tanino Gimlet walked away.
Just as I hurried to catch up with her,
I heard Dream Journey's voice from behind.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Even living in the dark,
there is light that can never be lost.
Truly, how precious..."
